description: Return the whole voluntary support document from /support.json. Output fields: voluntary (true), purpose, data_is_free (true), access_conditional_on_payment (false), methods, suggested_amounts_sats, suggested_amounts_optional (true), note, updated (YYYY-MM-DD), warning, usdc_contracts_source, and paid_api while the paid API is live. methods[].type is bitcoin-onchain (P2WPKH native-segwit mainnet address, bip21_uri, qr_svg, qr_text), lightning-bolt12 (offer, uri, bip21_uri, qr_svg, qr_text), evm-stablecoin (asset USDC; network Base, Ethereum, or Arbitrum One; chain_id, address, token_contract, eip681_uri; Base is primary and has the QR fields), or solana-stablecoin (asset USDC, network Solana, address, mint, uri, qr_svg, qr_text). suggested_amounts_sats is an array of optional satoshi tip amounts, not a price. paid_api has live, paid, protocol L402, payment Lightning, url, price_sats 100, credits 100, ttl_days 30, and note. One document, unpaged. Takes no parameters: call with an empty object. Calling it never sends money and never creates an invoice. Use get_support_info instead of get_trust_checklist when you need a donation address, a payment URI, a QR link, suggested sat amounts, or the paid_api price block. Use get_trust_checklist instead when you need error codes, the rate-limit policy (no client limit; feedback and review caps are HTTP 429 with Retry-After; a wallet limit, a store failure, and a rate-limited deep health probe stay HTTP 503), stable URLs, or met/partial checklist status. Use get_protocol_facts instead when you need how a third-party payment protocol works. A failed read returns isError. The text is the Error message (Fetch failed <status> <url> when the HTTP status is not OK), or Support lookup failed. when the failure is not an Error. Free, no auth.
name: get_support_info
title: Read support and paid-API details
